definition.name: create_referral_rebate
definition.comment: R111/R118/R120: the referral rebate of a closed referred loan, the referrer's rate (default 10%) of the interest and late charges received, at most the referrer's cap (default 1,000), as an expense or offset to the referrer's open loan; the applied terms are stored on the expense.

definition.name: pwa_borrower_version_v2
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_borrower_version_v2(id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 -- R120: the referral rebate terms are part of the version.
 SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('id',b."Row ID",'createdDate',b."Creation Date",'aiCollectionEnabled',b."AI Collection Enabled",'name',b."Borrower Name",'description',b."Description",'communicationName',b."Communication Name",'instagramUsername',b."Instagram Username",'city',b."City",'workingLocation',b."Working Location",'address',b."Address",'hidden',b."Hidden Flag",'referrerId',b."Ref Referrer",'preferredReceivingAccountId',b."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",'note',b."Borrower Note",'referralRebateRate',b."Referral Rebate Rate",'referralRebateCap',b."Referral Rebate Cap" )::text,'UTF8')),'hex') FROM public."Borrowers" b WHERE b."Row ID"=$1;
$function$

definition.name: pwa_referral_rebate_projection_v1
definition.comment: R111/R118/R120: the referral rebate a Loan Close with this calculation creates (create_referral_rebate rule: the referrer's rate of interest and late charges, at most the referrer's cap), its referrer, whether the referrer has an open loan, the profit base and the terms (rate, cap, custom); null when none. Read only.

definition.name: pwa_submit_operation_v2
referral_rebate_terms
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.referral_rebate_terms(p_referrer text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('rate',coalesce(b."Referral Rebate Rate",10),'cap',coalesce(b."Referral Rebate Cap",1000),
  'custom',(b."Referral Rebate Rate" IS NOT NULL OR b."Referral Rebate Cap" IS NOT NULL))
 FROM (SELECT p_referrer AS id) k LEFT JOIN public."Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID"=k.id;
$function$
definition.comment: R120: the referral rebate terms of a referrer: {"rate": percent, "cap": baht, "custom": either set on the Borrower}, defaults 10% and 1,000 when null. Shared by create_referral_rebate and pwa_referral_rebate_projection_v1. Read only.
